description: termios line discipline + ioctl(TCGETS/TCSETS/TIOCGWINSZ) over a pty slave (POSIX-gap list). Kernel Ioctl syscall (88) routes to the pty termios store (kernel/src/syscall/mod.rs sys_ioctl -> kernel/src/pty/mod.rs get_termios/set_termios/is_slave); the pty line discipline honours ICANON (line buffering + VERASE erase) and ECHO (kernel/src/pty/mod.rs master_write/slave_read_stdin). musl ioctl maps to 88 (tcgetattr/tcsetattr/isatty). /app/termios_test owns a pty and drives /app/musl_termios (the slave switches to canonical+echo, master types he<DEL>llo and verifies the echoed erase and the delivered line hllo). Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_termios_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 240 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: a pty slave is a tty and tcgetattr/tcsetattr round-trip through Ioctl TCGETS/TCSETS

required.marker: [TERMIOS] echo + erase bytes observed on master
required.claim: ECHO echoed the typed input and the VERASE erase emitted the backspace sequence
ICANON line-buffered the input, applied the backspace edit, and released the whole line on newline
the full termios round-trip passed end to end
